goal: Water reaches the system and moves through all of it
indicator: Visits with water at the inlet and no shortcuts (%)
method: Look at the inlet, the pump, and the flow path; short video

indicator: Sediment depth at each reference point (in), against the cleanout mark
method: Marked rod at the reference points
frequency: Pre-storm visit; quick look every visit

indicator: Outlet jar clearer than the inlet jar (yes / no)
method: Jars of inlet and outlet water, photographed side by side

goal: The system removes nitrate (TW, VD, WB)
indicator: Nitrate at the inlet and at the outlet (mg/L), and the difference
method: Test strip at each point, photographed with its color scale

indicator: Nitrate at the inlet and outlet from a laboratory (mg/L), and turbidity if measured
method: Laboratory analysis of one inlet and one outlet sample

goal: Plants hold the soil and do their job
indicator: Plant cover per zone (class); number of invasive species
method: Vegetation survey with the Field Guide

indicator: Number of findings at the condition check, and how many were repaired before October 1
method: Condition check with the drawing of the system

indicator: Repairs opened and closed in the year; problems that came back

method: Annual Plan against the Site History

goal: The site is documented over time
indicator: Overview photos from the same photo points
